commitMessage:
Migrate site to AEMaaCS: static->editable templates + component-rewrite rules

Skills: template-modernization

skillGaps.title: Template thumbnail.png migration is undocumented
skillGaps.detail: The static template dir contains thumbnail.png alongside .content.xml. The skill's editable-template file list is 4 files and never mentions thumbnails, so the thumbnail is lost on migration.
skillGaps.fix: Add a rule: copy thumbnail.png to /conf/<appId>/settings/wcm/templates/<tpl>/thumbnail.png and add it to the vault filter. PNG-only, filename must be thumbnail.png.

skillGaps.title: No 'no editable zone' classification for root-only templates
skillGaps.detail: SiteRoot's page component states 'Components are not allowed on this page', but the skill unconditionally emits an editable responsivegrid (editable="{Boolean}true"), exposing an author zone that should be locked.
skillGaps.fix: Add a classification: when the source page component has no cq:include/data-sly-resource editable area, emit a LOCKED <root> in structure/ (no editable="{Boolean}true") and an empty initial/.
